usage.outputShape: body.data[] (each item: title, summary, source, url, published_at, project_name, project_id, highlights); body.meta {total, limit, offset, credits_used, cached}
quirks: inputSchema is null in registry but the endpoint expects a ?q=<keyword> query param; calling without it would search nothing useful
results are AI-curated crypto/blockchain news (Surf feed) — topical to crypto, not general world news
usage.guide: Call GET https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/surf/search/news with a ?q=<keyword> query parameter (e.g. ?q=bitcoin). Pay $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base — no API key needed. Read the array at body.data[]; each element has title, summary, source, url, published_at (Unix seconds), and highlights with matched snippets. body.meta.total gives the result count. This is a crypto/blockchain news feed, so queries should be crypto-topical.
